updater._comment: WC-app-self-update: pubkey below is a PLACEHOLDER — a real minisign keypair must be generated (`npx tauri signer generate`) and its public key substituted before this can verify anything (see docs/wiki/Desktop-App-Updates.md). The endpoint here is a build-time fallback only, matching config.rs/build.rs's own compile-time default backend (https://whity.jameedium.org) for consistency; src-tauri/src/self_update.rs's runtime `app.updater_builder()` call always overrides it with this device's own chosen backend URL + bearer token, since both are only known at runtime. Must stay https:// — Tauri's updater refuses http:// in release builds.
